credit: NOAA GOES / ABI; NASA GIBS / ESDIS imagery service and color legend

legend.processing: New compact SVG drawn from the retained numeric source ColorMap entries. Same ordered RGB intervals, original Celsius temperature axis preserved, no invented thresholds; no-data remains transparent. Temperature labels are native Godot UI text because SVG text is not imported by Godot.

retrieval.projection: EPSG:4326, north-up, longitude -180 to 180, latitude 90 to -90

limits: Downsampled science visualization, not native 2km at every output pixel. Nominal scan time is not identical acquisition time per pixel. Region only; transparent pixels are unavailable/outside coverage, not proof of clear sky. No forecast, alert, rainfall or surface-air-temperature inference. No bundled current weather scene.
